question: Can the activation-conditioned downstream readers of the sealed conditional writer be composed into a substantially smaller executable response program without assuming additive singleton effects?
selection_authority: From the complete 60-site removal atlas, include every site whose absolute pooled signed necessity is at least 0.005 in behavior, canonical mode 1, or canonical mode 2. This deterministically yields L13H6, L15H1, L15H5, L17H2, and MLP12-17. No lattice outcome entered pool selection.
intervention: Replay the sealed mask-30 upstream writer. At all 60 downstream sites, install the cached live response for selected pool members and the cached native-base response otherwise. Execute all 1024 subsets, so serial/distributive interactions are measured rather than inferred from singleton additivity.
selection_rule: A subset is eligible when squared residual is at most 0.15 in each temporal/is-was x mode-1/mode-2 cell and in each task's behavior vector, and behavioral direction is positive on at least 90% of rows. Select the eligible subset with the fewest sites, then the smallest worst six-cell residual, then numeric mask. No fallback threshold or alternate pool is allowed.

predictions.instrument: Authorities, exact deterministic pool, native capture identity, all-base self-clamp, all-60 cached-live replay, attention reconstruction, canonical reader hash, finiteness, and 1036-forward/29008-example price close.
predictions.pool_sufficiency: The ten-site full mask has squared residual at most 0.10 in all six task-output cells and positive behavioral direction on at least 95% of rows.
predictions.compact_subset: At least one eligible subset uses at most eight of ten sites.
predictions.selected_program: The selected subset satisfies the frozen residual and behavioral-direction rule exactly, with no fitted coefficients.
predictions.complete_lattice: All 1024 subsets are evaluated once with zero fit, updates, or backwards passes; the result reports every arm and the exact selected mask.

decision: A pass licenses the selected cached-response program for a genuinely fresh population and component-removal confirmation. Failure of pool sufficiency expands from the causal atlas rather than relaxing thresholds; failure of compactness records a distributed downstream chain. This stage is composition/extraction evidence, not yet a literal weight program.
